steps.en: Add the plugin marketplace in Claude Code
steps.zh: 在 Claude Code 里添加插件市场

steps.en: Install the plugin and run the one-time setup
steps.zh: 安装插件并跑一次 setup

steps.en: Five core verbs and the Go guardrail engine become part of your session
steps.zh: 五个核心动词与 Go 护栏引擎接入你的会话

steps.en: Hand over one intent with a completion criterion
steps.zh: 交出一个意图和完成标准

steps.en: Drafts spec.md + Plans.md — scope, acceptance criteria, unknowns, stop conditions — for you to approve
steps.zh: 起草 spec.md + Plans.md：范围、验收标准、未知项、停止条件

steps.en: Approve or correct the contract, then execute the whole plan
steps.zh: 批准或修正契约，然后整盘执行

steps.en: Workers run tasks with required checks; each operation is adjudicated by the Go engine before executing
steps.zh: 工人按计划干活；每个操作执行前由 Go 引擎裁决放行或拒绝

steps.en: Review the result separately, then ship
steps.zh: 独立评审结果，然后发布

steps.en: Major findings block completion; the release packages only verified evidence
steps.zh: 重大问题拦住完成；发布只打包已验证的证据

value.en: Every feature lands as an approved contract, TDD-gated work, independent review, and guarded operations — instead of 'trust me, it works'
value.zh: 每个功能都落成批准的契约、TDD 门控、独立评审与执行前护栏，而不是「我测过了，放心」

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09-27 (raw.githubusercontent.com/Chachamaru127/claude-code-harness/main/README.md): 'Install in 30 seconds' block — `/plugin marketplace add Chachamaru127/claude-code-harness`, `/plugin install claude-code-harness@claude-code-harness-marketplace`, `/harness-setup`, `/harness-plan Improve the README onboarding flow`

README 'The loop' table: /harness-plan outputs spec.md + Plans.md (scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, unknowns, stop conditions); '/harness-work all' runs the whole approved plan; 'Your job is not to write the plan — it is to approve or correct it'

README 'The safety layer': 'Operations connected to CCH's checks are inspected by a Go engine before execution'; runtime floor 5 categories allow/deny with no global disable switch; Guardrails R01–R16 deny/confirm/warn
README loop table: /harness-review 'Major findings block completion'; /harness-release 'Packages only verified evidence into CHANGELOG, tag, and release. Release preflight must pass'
